answer: A farm running 35 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. Because the violet stake is held until the pulse settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the tundra audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 16% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
